topic: Saturn's shutdown command on Kuma failed because of his love for Bonney
title: Kuma's Shutdown Command Failed Because Of Bonney
description: Saturn's failsafe was supposed to erase Kuma's mind for good, but something in him broke through anyway at Egghead. Here's what actually happened in chapters 1103 and 1104. Do you think Kuma's mind is really gone?
comment: Do you think Kuma's mind is really gone for good, or is this coming back before the series ends?

lines.text: Saturn ordered Kuma's mind erased completely, and the shutdown should have been permanent.

shot.fallback: cyborg warrior frozen under a command

lines.text: Instead, something in him that wasn't supposed to exist anymore pulled him straight to Bonney.

shot.fallback: cyborg warrior walking through a storm

lines.text: Chapter 1103 shows Kuma reaching Egghead just as Saturn closes in on his own daughter.

shot.fallback: giant warrior arriving at a lab island

lines.text: One Armament Haki punch in chapter 1104 sends a Five Elder crashing through buildings.

shot.fallback: giant fist smashing through a building

lines.text: A mindless weapon isn't supposed to care who gets hurt.

shot.fallback: emotionless cyborg with a flicker of feeling

lines.text: Then Kuma does something no Pacifista has ever done again: he hugs her like a father.

shot.fallback: giant warrior hugging a pink haired woman

lines.text: Four years of silence, and the first thing his body chooses to do is hug his own daughter.

shot.search: Kuma four years reunion hug Bonney
shot.fallback: father and daughter reunited after years

lines.text: Vegapunk's own theory? Kuma's love for Bonney is what broke a command built to erase him.
So maybe the mind Saturn took was never fully gone. It was just waiting.

shot.fallback: cyborg warrior with a glimmer of awareness

lines.text: Which is why I don't think Saturn's order to erase Kuma's mind completely ever really worked.

shot.fallback: shadowy elder failing to control a warrior

self_check.loop: last line restates Saturn's order from line 1, framing it as failed

end_text: WHY KUMA REALLY GAVE IT UP
